description: Defines classes and functions related to oneDNN attribute handling, including quantization, post-ops, and binary operations for neural network layers.

classes.name: PostOpParam
classes.description: Represents parameters for different post operations (eltwise, sum, binary, prelu) in oneDNN.

classes.name: Attr
classes.description: Encapsulates attributes for oneDNN operations, including quantization scale, post-ops, and binary operation configurations.

methods.name: PostOpParam
methods.description: Constructors for different post operation parameter types.

methods.name: Attr
methods.description: Constructors and methods to build and extract post-ops, append operations, and manage quantization parameters.

methods.name: construct_attr_for_unary
methods.description: Builds unary post-ops based on string identifiers like relu, tanh, gelu, etc.

methods.name: construct_attr_by_post_op
methods.description: Builds combined post-ops based on binary and unary operation specifications.
